main_measure.name: mean short-signed unusual 3-bar move of the cases (vs coin's normal 3-bar drift)
main_measure.threshold: day-clustered t >= 2 to confirm (with slope t >= 2); t <= -2 or slope t <= -2 to reject

supporting_check.name: OLS slope of short-signed unusual move on |forecast|

decided_by: Neither rule met: the main t is between -2 and 2, or it is >= 2 with a slope t below 2 (or a statistic could not be computed).
reading: A case is the first short bet (rise of |forecast| >= 2 from its lowest level since the last bet) in each 3-bar cell counted from each window's first row; the day-clustered t sums deviations per UTC day with no small-sample correction; the slope t is the ordinary OLS t; the plan's 30-day minimum is applied as 'not observable'; the situation is read from the regime 'unknown' and raw value > 0.
